name: Seijo Densetsu -Five Holy Girls-
source:
The hero is a detective who chases the mysterious criminal girl Remy who is rumored to have stolen the treasure "GOLD LADY". In the game you get to interrogate girls one by one with the aim to get information about Remy.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1986.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名侦探，正在追捕神秘女罪犯蕾米娅。据说她偷走了宝物“黄金女郎”。游戏中，玩家要逐一盘问女孩，从她们口中取得有关蕾米娅的线索。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1986.html]vndbreview[/url]]
